payload.description:
Purpose: A Plexus Score subclass (not Tactus) that implements recall for scanner detections. YAML class: names this Python class. Scorecard loading registers it in plexus.scores.

Behavior:
- predict() reads repo, commit, file, and lines from the Item
- First call for a repo materializes and scans that repo
- The scorecard reuses one Score instance for the evaluation, so the scan cache lives on self
- Concurrent predict() calls for the same repo wait on one scan (evaluation concurrency is ~20)
- Returns Yes if a finding overlaps the span, otherwise No
- Unread files (not ingested) must not count as No/miss in recall — design still open (skip/NA)

Plexus-side work (class + registry) pairs with DataParade-side work (scanner callable without a full CLI subprocess maze). Massage before coding.
payload.title: Python detector Score with just-in-time per-repo scan
